title: Lesotho — Income Tax Return for Trusts and Estates (Form S128-TE)
description: Revenue Services Lesotho's (RSL) Form S128-TE, "Income Tax Return for Trusts and Estates for Year Ended 31 March 2020" — a companion Taxes schema for Lesotho, alongside the individual, company, and FBT returns already published from the same RSL forms library. A trust or a deceased estate's nominated officer uses this annual return to reconcile chargeable income (employment, pension, business, commercial farming, property, and other income), compute tax before and after credits, allocate income and foreign tax paid to beneficiaries, and report payments already made (PAYE, withholding tax, advance installments) against tax due or overpaid for the year. This v1.0.0 schema is scoped to the core declaration: identification (Details of Trust or Estate), Part A (Employment Income & Expenses), Part B (Pension Income), Part I (Tax Computation, Payments, and the resulting Tax Due/Overpaid), Part J (Information on Beneficiaries), and the Declaration of Paid Preparer / Declaration of Nominated Officer sections. Parts C-H (the detailed Business Income, Commercial Farming Income, Property Income, Other Income, and both Credit-for-Foreign-Tax-Paid schedules) and Part K (Allocation to Beneficiaries of Shares of Income and Foreign Tax Paid) are out of scope for this version and deferred to a future minor version, consistent with this registry's established main-form-now/companion-schedules-later precedent. GovSchema is an independent, non-profit standards body and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or operated by the Government of Lesotho or Revenue Services Lesotho.

verification.notes: GOV-4776 ("GovSchema Standard Research"). RSL's own "Forms & Instructions" page discloses two undated-looking editions of this form (one plain, one suffixed "-17022020"); both were downloaded and diffed, confirming the "-17022020" file is the Year Ended 31 March 2020 edition (the plain file is Year Ended 31 March 2019) — the current edition, since RSL's own site does not separately publish a later year for this particular form the way it does for the Individual and Company returns. The PDF is a flat (non-fillable/non-XFA) 7-page PDF with no AcroForm annotations; every field in this schema was cross-checked against the rendered page images (node-canvas at 2.5x scale), not the raw text layer alone. See this document's own VERIFICATION.md for the full sourcing record.

fields.name: isEstateInYearOfDeathOrFollowingYear
fields.label: Is this return for an estate for the year of a resident deceased's death or the following year?
fields.description: Not a printed checkbox on this form — this registry's own discriminator distinguishing the two mutually-exclusive filing scenarios that Part I's own "If this return is for: ► An estate for the year of a resident deceased's death or the following year / ► Any other estate or a trust" branching repeats at rows 3b, 3c, 3d, and 5a, matching this registry's isLegalEntity/isBodyCorporate discriminator precedent (e.g. tn/dgi/declaration-of-existence, zm/pacra/company-incorporation) for forms whose own conditional instructions have no single dedicated tick-box. When true, rows 3b/3c and the fraction-of-months personal tax credit apply; when false, row 3d (flat 40%) and a nil personal tax credit apply. See VERIFICATION.md.

fields.description: Corresponds to Part C (Business Income & Expenses), which is out of scope for this v1.0.0 schema and deferred to a future minor version. Enter 0 or leave blank if the trust or estate has no business income.

fields.name: taxComputationChargeableFarmingIncome
fields.label: 1d. Enter chargeable commercial farming income from Part D, line 10, col. (c)
fields.description: Corresponds to Part D (Commercial Farming Income & Expenses), which is out of scope for this v1.0.0 schema and deferred to a future minor version. Enter 0 or leave blank if the trust or estate has no commercial farming income. This same value is also the base for row 3a's flat 10% farming-income tax rate.

fields.name: taxComputationChargeablePropertyIncome
fields.label: 1e. Enter chargeable property income from Part E, line 14, col. (c)
fields.description: Corresponds to Part E (Property Income & Expenses), which is out of scope for this v1.0.0 schema and deferred to a future minor version. Enter 0 or leave blank if the trust or estate has no property income.

fields.name: taxComputationChargeableOtherIncome
fields.label: 1f. Enter chargeable other income from Part F, line 5, col. (c)
fields.description: Corresponds to Part F (Other Income & Expenses), which is out of scope for this v1.0.0 schema and deferred to a future minor version. Enter 0 or leave blank if the trust or estate has no other chargeable income.

fields.name: tax10PercentFarmingIncome
fields.label: 3a, col. (a). Amount on line 1d on this part (taxed at the fixed 10% rate)
fields.description: Row 3a applies a flat 10% rate specifically to chargeable commercial farming income (line 1d on this Part), ahead of the graduated/flat treatment applied to the rest of chargeable income in rows 3b-3d. Column (b), the 10% rate, is pre-printed on the form and not a fillable field.

fields.name: tax20PercentChargeableIncome
fields.label: 3b, col. (a). Chargeable income taxed at the 20% rate
fields.description: Only completed for an estate return for the year of a resident deceased's death or the following year: enter the smaller of (i) M61,080.00 or (ii) line 2 minus line 1d, if the deceased was engaged in an income-earning activity for the entire year (chargeable income must be apportioned if not). Any other estate or a trust skips this line and the next line and goes to row 3d (col. (b), the 20% rate, is pre-printed and not a fillable field).

fields.name: tax30PercentChargeableIncome
fields.label: 3c, col. (a). Chargeable income taxed at the 30% rate
fields.description: Only completed for an estate return for the year of a resident deceased's death or the following year: enter line 2 minus (lines 3a+3b in col. (a)), then skip line 3d and go to line 4. Any other estate or a trust skips this line and goes to row 3d (col. (b), the 30% rate, is pre-printed and not a fillable field).

fields.name: tax40PercentChargeableIncome
fields.label: 3d, col. (a). Chargeable income taxed at the 40% rate
fields.description: An estate return for the year of a resident deceased's death or the following year skips this line and goes to line 4. Any other estate or a trust enters line 2 minus line 1d here (col. (b), the 40% rate, is pre-printed and not a fillable field).

fields.name: totalTaxBeforeCredits
fields.label: 4. Total tax before credits (Add 3a+3b+3c+3d in col. (c))

fields.name: personalTaxCredit
fields.label: 5a. Personal tax credit
fields.description: For an estate return for the year of a resident deceased's death: multiply M8,430.00 by the fraction of the number of months in the year prior to the date of the deceased's death during which the deceased engaged in an income-earning activity divided by 12, and enter the result (but do not enter more than the amount of tax on the chargeable income received or accrued during the year prior to the date of the deceased's death). Any other estate return or a trust return enters nil.

fields.name: creditForForeignTaxPaid
fields.label: 5b. Credit for foreign tax paid from Part G, line 2
fields.description: Corresponds to Part G (Credit for Foreign Tax Paid on Income Taxed to the Trust or Estate), which is out of scope for this v1.0.0 schema and deferred to a future minor version. Enter 0 or leave blank if the trust or estate paid no foreign tax.
